notes: A license key that is refused now shows the reason, and a saved key that cannot be read no longer leaves the site stuck on the license page.
added: MagicCore Plugin downloads the Harmony mod or the Oxide/Carbon plugin. Servers report which one is connected.
Store checkout can gift a package to a Steam ID.
Custom pages have a description, and the editor includes a Markdown reference.
changed: API keys are a short list: create a key, turn it on or off, or add a key you already have.
Hidden admin menu items stay hidden, including on the page you are viewing.
The Harmony mod page opens the MagicCore Plugin page.
